intent.verbatim: a raw < in a handoff or promise silently breaks the substrate — every hand-authored xml has to actually parse
intent.decoded: Every hand-authored substrate XML artifact (canon, schemas, the bench task set itself) parses as well-formed XML; a malformed file fails the gate.

contract.goal: `tests/xmlcheck.py` exits 0 (all substrate XML well-formed) and the bench task set itself parses.

check.expect: exit 0: every globbed substrate XML file is well-formed

check.run: python3 -c "import glob,xml.etree.ElementTree as E; [E.parse(f) for f in glob.glob('bench/tasks/*.xml')]"
check.expect: exit 0: all bench task promises parse

contract.out-of-scope: Schema validity beyond well-formedness; xmlcheck gates parse, not content.
contract.regression-surface: A malformed promise/handoff must fail pre-commit AND CI, not be skipped.
